newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Jilin Paper plans IPO of 60 mln A shares.
newsitem.headline: China Jilin Paper plans IPO of 60 mln A shares.

text.p: Jilin Paper Industry Co Ltd plans to launch an initial public offer of 60 million A shares early in April for listing on the Shenzhen bourse, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

The company, a press and packaging paper manufacturer, will soon file an application to China Securities Regulatory Commission for the issue, the official told China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter, on Wednesday.
Shenzhen Changcheng Securities Co will be the lead underwriter for the offer, but the issuing price has not been set, the official said.
"Proceeds from the issue will be used to buy a 770-million-yuan assembly-line with an annual production capacity of 100,000 tonnes of high-grade press paper," he said.
"The facility, which we expect to put into operation at the end of 1998, will increase Jilin Paper's effectiveness," the official said.
Jilin Paper forecast a net profit of about 67 million yuan for 1997, the official said without giving comparative figures.
It has an annual capacity of 200,000 tonnes of paper products but output only reached 165,000 tonnes in 1996, he said.

The company, based in the city of Jilin in northeastern Jilin Province, has 166 million outstanding shares, comprising 126 million state shares, seven million legal person shares and 33 million staff shares.
